onlyNew: "note": "A Zodiacs-owned draft vocabulary, not an industry interoperability standard. Each calculation record names the set it was computed under in receipt.conventions, and from <version> lists the ids of the Zodiacs conventions registry that it names in receipt.conventionIds.
